question: Should this behavior-preserving meeting refactor receive a proof override, or should it include redacted after-fix evidence from a real meeting setup/startup path before merge?
rationale: The supplied evidence establishes test and static validation, but OpenClaw PR policy requires observed real behavior for external PRs unless a maintainer deliberately overrides that gate.

options.title: Add redacted runtime proof
options.body: Attach a terminal trace, redacted runtime log, or recording that shows an affected meeting path still reaches the expected readiness/startup result after this refactor.

options.title: Grant a proof override
options.body: A maintainer may explicitly waive live proof if the refactor's no-behavior-change claim and focused parity coverage are accepted for this change.
